description: This file is a PHP-based web page for managing local IP configuration settings of a network gateway device. It includes PHP code to retrieve current network settings, and embedded JavaScript for client-side validation and user interaction. It covers IPv4 and IPv6 configuration, DHCP server settings, IP address ranges, and UI elements for adjusting network parameters.

methods.name: calcuate_lease_time
methods.description: Calculates DHCP lease time in seconds based on the input number and unit (seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, forever).

methods.name: display_time_format
methods.description: Displays the DHCP lease time in a human-readable format and updates the corresponding select element.

methods.name: display_time_format_V6
methods.description: Displays the IPv6 DHCP lease time in a human-readable format and updates the corresponding select element.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into an array of hextets for display or manipulation.
